# CyberLink

> CyberLink is a leading provider of AI-powered creative software for video editing, photo editing, media playback, and facial recognition across Windows, iOS, and Android platforms.

CyberLink offers a comprehensive suite of consumer and enterprise creative tools including PowerDirector, PhotoDirector, PowerDVD, and FaceMe. The company specializes in AI-enhanced multimedia software for content creators, businesses, and developers seeking professional-grade editing and recognition capabilities.

## Key Topics

- PowerDirector
- PhotoDirector
